A [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979]] '''landing craft''' was used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="SW: Obi-Wan" /> to [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invade]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] escaped from the Trade Federation [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|Saak'ak]] aboard this craft. He was ordered by his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], to disable the craft's communications to prevent the craft from warning the rest of the invasion force of the stowaway.<ref name="SW: Obi-Wan" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)}}
Kenobi engaged the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] droids guarding the communication gears. In the fighting, the equipment recessed under protective covers. With the droids gone, he hit switches to expose the gear. With a slash of his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], he disabled the gear. The loss of communications attracted the attention of the other droids onboard. [[Battle droid squad 8313]] was sent to investigate. Kenobi destroyed those droids then continued through the ship, ending up in the first [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] storage bay. He cut through the droids stationed there and went through the second Armored Assault Tank storage bay.

Jinn contacted Kenobi again and told him to go to the engine room or the main control room to disable the craft and force it to land. Kenobi went to the atmospheric turbine room, destroyed the two droids guarding it, and operated both sets of controls to shut down the turbines. Droid [[8557]] was sent to carry out an investigation, but this was cut short by a sweep of Kenobi's lightsaber. Kenobi then went through the door 8557 had unlocked and ended up in the navigation room. The young Jedi destroyed all the present droids and disabled the hologram of Naboo, allowing him to access the platform under the hologram emitter. Kenobi followed the path and ended up on the upper catwalk of the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] bay. He descended to the main floor and went to the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], where he engaged a [[Trade Federation assassin droid|new type of assassin droid]] armed with a [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] blade. After defeating it, Jinn ordered Kenobi to find cover until the ship landed.<ref name="SW: Obi-Wan" />
{{Endgame}}

Once on the planet Kenobi jumped out of the craft and fled into the swamps of Naboo to rejoin Master Jinn.<ref name="Episode I: Obi-Wan Kenobi">''[[Episode I: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1999]] video game [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]] shows Kenobi infiltrating a C-9979 landing craft in a cutscene. Kenobi can be seen jumping out of the craft in the 1999 [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] ''[[Episode I: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''. The craft's appearance in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] during the mission ''Stowaway'' contradicts the internal layout of the C-9979 landing craft seen in ''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''. In the game, the player assumes the role of Kenobi, and the player can use his lightsaber or Force powers to proceed through the enemy droids, or avoid them altogether. The path under the navigation room is an option, and the player may take a longer route to the MTT storage bay. The player must open the hangar door, then take the elevator down to the bay. This article assumes the player took the shortcut.
